title: Tearstain Drill
prompt: aphex twin. Energy: dense/driving drill'n'bass. Register focus: melody-led over chopped breaks. Palette: AkaiLinn break bank + square/FM lead. Tempo: 165 BPM. Arc shape: early peak then deconstruction into a stutter-edit finale. Mood modifier: frantic but melancholic.
description: A frantic drill'n'bass workout that hits its peak early, then patiently unravels: a square-and-FM lead sings a melancholy minor melody over chopped AkaiLinn breaks that ratchet, stutter and degrade. Euclidean ghost hats skitter underneath while the whole thing collapses into a glitching stutter-edit finale, tails bleeding only through delay.
code:
setcpm(165/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd ~]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.95),
    s("hh(3,8,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    n("0 ~ 4 7").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(900).delay(".4:.166:.5")
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0).ply("<1 1 2 1>"),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.55).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    n("0 2 4 7 6 4 2 0").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.55).lpf(saw.slow(24).range(700,2600)).crush(8).delay(".35:.125:.5"),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.6).shape(0.3)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2 4 2>")),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.55).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.25,0.75)),
    s("oh(3,8)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    n("0 2 4 7 6 4 7 9").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.11).sustain(0).gain(0.58).fm(4).fmh(2).lpf(2400).crush(8).off(0.0625, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)).delay(".4:.166:.55"),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.62).shape(0.35)
  )],
  [20, stack(
    s("bd(3,8) ~ sd").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.85),
    n("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("square").decay(0.5).sustain(0.2).gain(0.55).lpf(1400).vowel("<a o e>").delay(".5:.25:.6"),
    n("0 ~ 7 ~").scale("C4:minor").s("sine").decay(0.3).sustain(0).gain(0.4).delay(".5:.375:.6")
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0).every(2, x => x.ply("<1 2 4 8>")),
    s("hh(9,16,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.55).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)).sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("oh(3,8,1)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2 0 3 5 7 6 4 2 0").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.58).fm(5).fmh(3).lpf(saw.slow(28).range(1200,3400)).crush(7).jux(rev).delay(".35:.166:.55"),
    n("<0 0 5 3>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.62).shape(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply(2))
  )],
  [20, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.9).ply("<1 4 8 16>").degradeBy(0.15),
    s("hh(5,8,1)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1).every(2, x => x.ply("<2 4>")),
    n("0 2 4 7 6 4 2 0").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.55).fm(6).fmh(2).crush(6).every(2, x => x.rev()).sometimesBy(0.4, x => x.ply("<2 4>")).delay(".3:.125:.6")
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd ~]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.85).degradeBy(0.2),
    n("0 ~ 4 ~").scale("C3:minor").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(1000).delay(".5:.25:.6")
  )]
)
